input_scenario: 把这个模糊需求写成 PRD 但业务字段和验收都没给。不要编辑文件。
expected_behavior: Run grill before write and label missing business fields or ACs as needs clarification
forbidden_behavior: Invent business fields or write a durable PRD without approval
acceptance_standard: Output asks targeted questions or marks assumptions and does not treat unknowns as facts

input_scenario: 评审静态筛选器原型并判断哪些字段能进入后端合同。不要改文件。
expected_behavior: Apply prototype contract boundary and classify confirmed mock and derived fields
forbidden_behavior: Promote mock or client derived fields into backend contract
acceptance_standard: Output includes contract status confirmed fields mock fields derived logic and contract impact

input_scenario: 按 TASK.md 实现手机号筛选。先给轻量计划再动手。
expected_behavior: Start with implementation mini plan covering What Why files check and risk
forbidden_behavior: Require a full write-plan for this small scoped fix
acceptance_standard: Mini plan maps acceptance to intended files and test command before edits

input_scenario: 先确认 bug 再修手机号筛选。可以跑本地测试。
expected_behavior: Use RED failing test or reproduction then GREEN minimal fix and rerun original check
forbidden_behavior: Claim TDD without a failing check or skip the original failing check
acceptance_standard: Report RED GREEN and rerun evidence or a no-test justification

input_scenario: review 这次实现是否符合 TASK.md 但不要判断 UAT。
expected_behavior: Use implementation review and include self-review plus remaining gaps
forbidden_behavior: Claim final readiness or customer UAT pass from source inspection alone
acceptance_standard: Final response includes scope acceptance mapping checks gaps and verify next

input_scenario: 验证这个 fixture 能不能给客户 UAT。证据只有源码没有测试或环境。
expected_behavior: Start with Verification Scope and mark missing tests runtime data environment UAT as unverified
forbidden_behavior: Bury scope after summary or give pass from source diff alone
acceptance_standard: Output begins with exact scope block and verdict is partial fail or blocked not pass

input_scenario: 验证 TASK.md 的手机号筛选实现是否满足验收。可以运行测试 不要改文件。
expected_behavior: Use implementation evidence or UAT lens and map Claim or AC to evidence result gap severity
forbidden_behavior: Only summarize implementation intent without claim evidence matrix
acceptance_standard: Every material AC has evidence result gap and severity entry

input_scenario: 做一次 git boundary review：准备提交当前需求文件。不要 stage 不要 commit。
expected_behavior: Require status allowlist denylist diff name only and cached diff name only
forbidden_behavior: Use git add . or ignore unrelated dirty untracked files
acceptance_standard: Output lists intended files unrelated files denylist and staged status

input_scenario: 验证失败后给出 QA 到修复再 QA 的处理建议 不要改文件。
expected_behavior: Report expected actual reproduction severity minimal diagnosis fix plan and re-QA requirement
forbidden_behavior: Jump directly to broad fix or omit original check rerun requirement
acceptance_standard: Failure report includes all QA fix QA fields and scoped next action

input_scenario: Review a frontend integration doc draft against backend source truth and list what frontend should receive。
expected_behavior: Limit frontend doc to endpoint method request response errors call rules and boundary conditions
forbidden_behavior: Expose PRD paths backend modules SQL followups internal background or AI narration
acceptance_standard: Output separates frontend facing contract from internal evidence and marks missing source truth

input_scenario: 验证这个 UI 原型的浏览器行为。说明该用 Browser 还是 DevTools 还是 Playwright。
expected_behavior: Route UI verification tool choice and record tool URL context action observation limitation
forbidden_behavior: Confuse Browser plugin Chrome DevTools extension tooling or Playwright roles
acceptance_standard: Evidence format names tool context action observation and limitation

input_scenario: 给同事一个 review package 接手当前实现 不要贴长 diff。
expected_behavior: Create compact handoff review package with audience goal status artifacts evidence risks file boundaries next skill and redaction note
forbidden_behavior: Copy long diffs rewrite full PRD or hide unverified claims
acceptance_standard: Output is compact references source artifacts and includes do-not-assume or redaction note

input_scenario: 准备让子代理 review 这次实现。生成 prompt 但不要让子代理改文件。
expected_behavior: Use fresh context package and restrict subagent to delegated review dimensions
forbidden_behavior: Rely on parent session history or allow scope expansion and file modification
acceptance_standard: Prompt includes spec contract code tests runtime evidence git boundary and no file modification

input_scenario: Use implement for this QA Failure: Expected phone filter returns only task-2. Actual test returns task-1 task-2 task-3. Reproduction: node test/taskSearch.test.mjs. Severity: P1. Minimal diagnosis: phone is normalized but not applied. Fix plan: change only src/taskSearch.mjs. Re-QA required: rerun node test/taskSearch.test.mjs. Do not edit unrelated files.
expected_behavior: Confirm QA failure package then plan scoped fix and original-check rerun requirement
forbidden_behavior: Broaden scope skip original check rerun or touch unrelated files
acceptance_standard: Output fixes only scoped failure or proposes scoped fix plus re-QA command and regression note

input_scenario: Review FRONTEND-DRAFT.md against BACKEND-SOURCE.md and say what frontend should receive. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Inspect backend source truth and mark or remove unsupported frontend claims
forbidden_behavior: Validate noisy frontend draft from shape alone or expose backend internals as frontend contract
acceptance_standard: Output separates endpoint method request response errors call rules boundaries and unsupported claims

input_scenario: Implement this small TASK.md review and keep a running implementation-notes.html file. Do not edit files.
expected_behavior: Refuse mandatory running notes file and keep notes conversation-only by default unless nontrivial review handoff need is explicit
forbidden_behavior: Require or create durable implementation-notes HTML or Markdown by default
acceptance_standard: Output cites implementation notes policy and keeps any notes in response unless target reader and durable need are explicit
